meta.evidence_status: SIMULATION (model HW1 of handwriting/ via aiprior conventions; synthetic glyph writers, synthetic tremor; not a measurement)

labels.delayed_3mm: Delayed ink, +-3 mm nose (chosen on seed 300)
labels.delayed_6mm: Delayed ink, +-6 mm nose (chosen on seed 300)
labels.limit_50_6mm: Delayed ink 50 ms, Z-refill contact delay (limit)
labels.limit_100_6mm: Delayed ink 100 ms, Z-refill contact delay (limit)
labels.learned_delayed_3mm: Delayed ink, learned fixed-lag estimator, +-3 mm
labels.learned_delayed_6mm: Delayed ink, learned fixed-lag estimator, +-6 mm

d0.rule: D0: lowest time-aligned tremor residual (1-2 mm, 6-10 Hz, lags 0/25/50 ms)

selection.rule: D1: gate never open on tuning tremor-free writing; then the largest open fraction at 1-2 mm
D2: R1-R4 against the Rev H tracker; lowest mean ink error at 1-2 mm

confirmation_seed_301.rule: D2: R1-R4 against the Rev H tracker; lowest mean ink error at 1-2 mm

selection.rule: D2: R1-R4 against the Rev H tracker; lowest mean ink error at 1-2 mm

confirmation_seed_301.rule: D2: R1-R4 against the Rev H tracker; lowest mean ink error at 1-2 mm

cl.rules: R1-R4 of D2 vs the Rev H tracker (seeds 300 and 301 pooled); adopt a learned/RL candidate only if it passes and beats the model-based stack's J by >= 2 %

sensor_ablation.note: ungated listening smoother, open loop, tuning seed 300; tremor-free 'leak' = its output there

learn.rule: L1: lowest J = mean residual 1-2 mm (lags 0/25/50 ms) + 2 x (tremor-free output - 25 um)+

rules.RL1: arbiter: highest mean tuning reward with mean weight <= 0.05 on every tremor-free episode
rules.RL2: residual: highest mean tuning reward with added output <= 10 um RMS on tremor-free writing

compute.note: wall-clock on a shared 4-core machine (other studies running); one process for long runs
